items.title: Fall Travel Bags That Can Handle “Just One More Sweater”
items.summary: There's something about traveling in the fall that just feels different. The air is crisper, the colors are richer, and somehow, your packing list is a little… fluffier. Maybe it's those chunky cable knits you can't leave behind or that blanket scarf that feels like an emotional support accessory. And while you could try to be ruthless about what makes the cut, we say bring it all. The trick isn't traveling with less; it's traveling smarter. That means choosing luggage and bags that can keep you organized, handle the bulk, and still look like they belong in your travel photos. Whether you're heading for leaf-peeping drives, cabin weekends, or a whirlwind Friendsgiving, these Vera Bradley favorites will have you packing bulky sweaters without breaking a sweat. Miramar Weekender Your weekend bag should work as hard as you do. Lucky for you, the Miramar Weekender overnight bag knows how to pull its weight when you're on a brief getaway. Smart organization and carry-on compliance mean you've officially cracked the code on how to pack bulky sweaters and still zip your bag with room to spare. Toss in your boots, your favorite scarf, and yes, that extra cardigan, and you're good to go. The detachable strap and trolley sleeve keep you moving comfortably, whether you're dashing to catch a train or gliding through the airport. "Great size, comfortable and good quality. Perfect for a short weekend trip!" ~ Cara 22" Adair Spinner Perfect for those who like to travel light but stylish, the 22" Adair Spinner carry-on is all about ease in motion. Smooth-glide spinner wheels and a telescopic handle mean you're navigating airports like a pro. Compression panels inside help maximize space, so learning how to pack for cold weather feels easy (even with your chunkiest sweaters in tow). "Took it on a 5-day trip and it was perfect! Love the zipper compartment to keep everything in place!" ~ Jeannie 26" Adair Spinner For longer escapes (or when you can't decide which sweaters to leave behind), the 26" Adair Spinner suitcase offers the same sleek design and effortless maneuverability as its smaller sibling, but with extra room to play. The expandable panel is your secret weapon for spontaneous shopping finds during your fall travels. "Probably the cutest and most unique suitcase I've ever come across ... The materials are high quality, the wheels glide well, and the suitcase is a great size." ~ Payton Large Original Duffel Bag This is the duffel that says yes to last-minute plans. Roomy, lightweight, and versatile, our Large Original Duffel is ideal for tossing in chunky knits, a cozy throw, and maybe a bottle of cider for that cabin trip you have planned this fall. Three interior slip pockets keep smaller items from getting lost in the shuffle, making it a smart choice for weekend warriors who love organized chaos. "I love this bag! It's adorable, super roomy and holds everything I need for a night away from home." ~ Emily Favorite Fall Travel Accessories Jewelry Roll Your statement earrings and delicate chains deserve as much protection as your wardrobe. This Jewelry Roll keeps everything tangle-free with a luxe faux suede lining, so you can change your look from hiking trail to dinner party without a second thought. "Perfect size for travel, plenty of useable space for assorted jewelry, lovely pattern too." ~ Paula Travel Pill Case Cold-weather travel often means vitamins, supplements, or medications are in the mix. The Travel Pill Case keeps them neatly organized in a zippered case that slips right into your carry-on, proving that practicality can be pretty. "Such a pretty addition to travel with. The zippered case makes sure that pill box doesn't open during transit." ~ Patrice Woodward Small Belt Bag For days filled with apple-picking, farmers' markets, or exploring a new town, the Woodward Small Belt Bag keeps your essentials close and your hands free. Card slots, a key loop, and a zip pocket make it as functional as it is stylish. "Perfect size and plenty of room for everything I need." ~ Debbi Be Ready for Your Next Fall Escape with the Right Travel Bag Packing for cooler weather doesn't have to mean stuffing and struggling. The right bag turns how to pack for cold weather into a satisfying part of the journey—almost as fun as the trip itself. Whether you're road-tripping under golden leaves or flying cross-country for a festive gathering, these Vera Bradley travel companions are here to keep your sweaters, scarves, and sense of adventure right where they belong. Because fall is fleeting, but the right bag? That's forever. SHOP ALL TRAVEL BAGS & ACCESSORIES

items.title: Start High School Right With a Backpack You Love
items.summary: High school is filled with big moments, new experiences, and a schedule that can feel like a marathon. And the right backpack can help you get through it all. From early morning classes to late-night study sessions (with sports, clubs, and a quick snack break in between), you need a bag that works as hard as you do. And, of course, it has to look amazing doing it! We've rounded up the best backpacks for high school that blend fashion with function, plus the matching lunch coolers that look nothing like the ones in the cafeteria line. Why the Right Backpack Makes All the Difference Your backpack is more than just a place to stash books. It's a statement about your style, your organizational skills, and your ability to keep it together no matter what your schedule throws your way. Here's what makes a backpack worth carrying into the school year: • Smart storage for laptops, books, water bottles, and the inevitable “I'll just bring it in case” items. • Durable designs that stand up to crowded hallways, bus rides, and every drop-and-go moment. • Comfortable carry with adjustable straps so your shoulders aren't begging for mercy by lunchtime. • Style that speaks because you are not just showing up; you are showing up as yourself. Need help deciding? Check out our Backpack Comparison Guide Style Meets Function: Backpacks and Lunch Bags Worth Carrying Every Day The right bag carries everything you need for your day, while setting the tone for it. Our Bancroft lineup and insulated lunch companions are made for high schoolers who need space for books, laptops, sports gear, snacks, and accessories… but refuse to give up style for storage. Whether you're after the best backpacks for high school, something sleek for everyday use, or extra-large backpacks for high school that can take on any schedule, these picks check all the boxes. Bancroft Backpack Compact but never cramped, the Bancroft Backpack is your go-to for days when you need the essentials plus a little extra. It's perfect for students who carry their laptop, a few binders, and still want a spot for a water bottle (or two). The clean, structured design looks as good in the hallway as it does on the weekend, and the front pocket keeps pens, chargers, and ID cards right where you need them. "Amazing backpack with so many pockets and extra space!" ~ Nargess Large Bancroft Backpack When your schedule runs from first bell to after-practice dinner, the Large Bancroft Backpack has the stamina to keep up. With three roomy compartments, a padded laptop sleeve, and easy-to-reach side pockets, it's built for busy days. The design is polished enough to match your personal style while holding everything from textbooks to a change of clothes for after-school activities. "Even more roomy than described! Fabric is nice and I think it's going to hold up well to my teens busy schedule!" ~ Andrea XL Bancroft Backpack For the student whose backpack is basically a mobile locker, this is the ultimate choice in extra-large backpacks for high school. It not only fits up to a 17" laptop but also has an expansion panel for those days when you're carrying sports gear, art projects, and every school book you need for the day. Thoughtful organization keeps it all neat, so you can find your homework before the bell rings. "LOADS of room, lots of pockets. Very well made; very pretty." ~ Melissa Just Right Bancroft Backpack Some days call for “just enough” space, and that's exactly what this backpack delivers. The Just Right Bancroft backpack is lightweight, comfortable, and easy to carry, with two compartments and a padded laptop sleeve. Ideal for high schoolers who want a streamlined look without giving up smart storage. "Perfect size with excellent compartment placement." ~ Rita Lunch Bag Say goodbye to the sad brown paper sack. This insulated Lunch Bag keeps your food fresh and looks great doing it. Small enough to slip into your backpack yet roomy enough for all your favorites, it's perfect for students who want to bring their lunch without carrying a separate, bulky tote. "Just as pictured, great size for school lunch." ~ Amanda Lunch Tote When you want your lunch to ride in style, the Lunch Tote is your pick. With more space than the standard Lunch Bag, it can handle containers, drinks, and snacks, plus the top handle makes it easy to grab and go. The best part? It looks more like an accessory than a cooler. "Beautiful lunch bag... Plenty of room for everything including a water bottle." ~ Bianca Your School Year, Your Way The best part about starting school with a Vera Bradley backpack is that you get to choose your vibe. Go bold with bright patterns, keep it neutral and timeless, or mix-and-match with a lunch bag in a complementary print. Whether you're carrying sports gear, your laptop, or the world's largest math textbook, there's a bag ready to handle it. Start high school with a backpack you actually love carrying!
